get.description: Completed daily model estimates, newest first. Uses saved coordinates, time zone and units. Provide both dates for a custom period of up to 366 days; otherwise days selects a trailing range. Missing readings remain null. Soil moisture is volumetric water content at 0–7 cm, not a field sensor or root-zone measurement. An optional field_id selects field coordinates and the caller's time zone and returns estimated crop limits and daily risk assessments; climate context uses this requested history window.

get.description: 14 daily forecasts, oldest first, starting today in the saved time zone. Shares a 10-minute upstream cache with current weather. Metrics are nullable, wind is the daily maximum and soil moisture is the daily mean at 0–1 cm. An optional field_id returns backend crop limits, suitability scores and structured daily alerts using a versioned illustrative estimator. Its climate context is the forecast window, not long-term climate normals. Omitting field_id preserves account-location weather and returns null cropAssessment. This is not a calibrated agronomic prediction.
